title: Flat Panel TV Tilt-Mount Brackets Recalled by Circuit City Stores Inc. Due to Risk of Falling Units
summary: If upward force is applied to a mounted television, the bracket's lock bar could unfasten. This could cause the television to fall and injure bystanders. Units: About 9,900.

title: Small World Toys Recalls Children's Wooden Sound Puzzles with Knobs for Choking Hazard
summary: The knobs on the recalled puzzle pieces can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 78,500.

title: SRAM Corp. Recalls Bicycle Brake Caliper Sets Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake caliper sets could break and detach from the bicycle's fork or frame. This could cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: .

title: Aviv Judaica Imports and Ahron's Judaica Recall Chanukah Candles Due To Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The oil candles can become engulfed in flames and melt the plastic cups holding the candles in place, allowing hot wax to leak out, which poses fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 9,000.

title: Gemmy Industries Corp. Recalls Disney Plush Easter Baskets Sold at Wal-Mart Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Silver beads and ribbons attached to the basket can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,500.

title: NY Thermal Inc. Recalls to Repair Gas-Fired Hot Water Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: Acidic liquid in a drain line can cause a fitting in the boiler to leak, posing a risk of carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning to consumers. Units: About 4,800.

title: Sears Warns Consumers to Remove Label from Craftsman Circular Saws, Obstructed Blade Guard Poses Laceration Hazard
summary: The "Craftsman" logo label located on the upper blade guard can become partially detached and interfere with the proper operation of the lower blade guard, exposing the saw's blade and posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 308,000.

title: Intex Recreation Corp. Recalls Ladders for Above-Ground Pools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ladder's plastic steps can be assembled backward on the support brackets. If this happens, the ladder steps can break and the user can fall. Units: About 3,500.

title: OKK Trading Recalls Baby Dolls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: These dolls contain small parts, which can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,500.

title: Target Recalls Activity Cart Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The orange hubcaps on the wheels of the cart can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 18,500.

title: A&A Global Industries Recalls Children's Bracelets Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The paint on the metallic band beneath the decorative cover contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 4 million.

title: Mastex Recalls Foot Warmer Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The wiring in the foot warmer has a defect, which can cause it to overheat. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: Various Metal Key Chains Recalled by Dollar General for Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The key chains contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 396,000.

title: Polaris Industries Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Loss of Control Hazard
summary: The right and left front suspension shock towers can separate due to inadequate welding during the manufacturing process. Separation of the welded joints can result in stiffer steering or the shock mount failing suddenly, causing the rider to lose control of the snowmobile and crash. Units: About 2,

title: The Holmes Group Recalls Oil-Filled Electric Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A poor electrical connection within the heater can lead to overheating. This poses fire and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 300,000.

title: Acer America Corporation Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Previous Fires
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 27,800.

title: Coby Electronics Recalls Boomboxes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When left plugged into an electrical outlet and the off switch is not firmly in place, these boomboxes can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 13,800.

title: iObjectSolutions Inc. Recalls Pre-Lit Palm Trees Due to Shock, Fire Hazards
summary: If the electrical connectors are not fully inserted, they can overheat and pose electric shock and fire hazards. Units: About 1,200.

title: Magnetix Magnetic Building Set Recall Expanded Serious Injuries Continue to be Reported to CPSC
summary: If a child swallows more than one tiny powerful magnet detached from the plastic building pieces or one such magnet and a metallic object, the objects can attract to each other inside the intestines and cause perforations and/or blockage, which can be fatal, if not treated immediately. Units: In exc

title: Hunter's View Expands Recall of Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands, Also Recalls Harnesses Provided as Replacements
summary: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in a hunter falling from the tree stand and suffering serious injuries or death. Units: About 200,000 additional harnesses (This recall was first announced in April 2005).

title: Infant Bouncer Seats Recalled Due to Frame Failure
summary: The tubular metal frame can break, posing a fall hazard to infants in the seat. Units: About 1,400.

title: Lamson & Sessions Recalls Floor Electrical Outlets Due to Shock or Electrocution Hazards
summary: The recalled floor boxes are wired incorrectly, resulting in reverse polarity. This poses a shock or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 100,000.

title: Tequila Rose Distilling Co. Recalls Gel Candles Due To Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The martini glass containing the gel candle can break while the candle is burning, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 60,000.

title: 900,000 Children's Necklaces and Charm Bracelets Recalled by Cardinal Distributing Co. Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The paint on this jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 900,000.

title: Disney Store Recalls Children's Footed Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard
summary: This sleepwear fails to meet the children's flammability standard, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 200.

title: DreamWorks Animation SKG Recalls Shrek Headbands Due to Injury Hazard; Giveaway Product Distributed To Pepsi Employees
summary: A small wire can protrude through the fabric of the ears on these headbands, posing a risk of cuts to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Life is good® Children's Sweatshirts Recalled by RedEnvelope; Garments Have Drawstrings, Pose Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,200.
